paragraphs: Review for “Formal Verification in Hybrid Quantum-Classical Computing Systems”
Always remember when you introduce or propose something, you need to explain what this is briefly, what’s this for, and why we need this.

Table I is just a summary of all system-level obligations evaluated in this study and their pre-execution/runtime mappings, not a table exhaustively covers every possible verification requirement for VQE. We need to justify this setting
You didn’t justify and explain why we use the Gaussian DTMC in probabilistic verification, this is important and good for review to understand our choice
L4 result in Table IV “Qualified agreement” or “Agreement under mapping”

Captions in all tables and figures contain too much information and details. You need to judge which figure/table caption should include more details and explanation and analysis, which figure/table caption just keeps concise and informative

Merge Table V and Table VI, don’t include these columns “|∆p| (pp)”, “ Holm p”, “Absolute deviation”, or just remove these two tables completely, and explain and analyze the results in the section they belong. You need to judge which choice is better
The “ASSUMPTION_MISMATCH” is an indicator or verdict result of fault injection; we need to justify and explain why we use this term in the beginning
“requirement” or “obligation”, which one is better? I think “requirement” sounds more natural and intuitive, replace “obligation” when appropriate
